trigger_condition: check_handshake_state called when global codemie binary is found on PATH
potential_consequence: Blocking std::process::Command::output() ties up Tokio worker; concurrent IPC commands delayed or starved
global_version is None even though global_found is true; UI receives inconsistent handshake state

trigger_condition: Windows user with no HOME environment variable set (USERPROFILE only)
potential_consequence: config_path() resolves to '/.codemie/...'; config always reads as no-configuration on Windows

trigger_condition: user activates the Install Only wizard path (enterWizard(INSTALL_ONLY_IDS))
guard_snippet: const INSTALL_ONLY_IDS = null; // acquisition steps removed; or remove the install-only entry point
potential_consequence: Step IDs 1.1, 1.1.1, 1.3 no longer exist in steps.yaml; engine is built with 0 steps and completes silently

trigger_condition: spawn_pty called while a PTY child is already running in state.pty
guard_snippet: if state.pty.lock().unwrap().is_some() { return Err(InstallerError::Pty("PTY already active".into())); }
potential_consequence: Prior child process is leaked (no kill); its stale wait-thread emits a stale engine:pty-exit event with the old run_id

trigger_condition: bundled node.exe hangs or stalls on startup (network wait, corrupted binary)
potential_consequence: IPC call run_self_update never resolves; UI 'Updating...' spinner hangs indefinitely

trigger_condition: server responds with a malformed or adversarially large Content-Length header
potential_consequence: Vec::with_capacity(total as usize) on an untrusted u64 can exhaust address space and panic the process

trigger_condition: download_file is called for a large file (e.g. a sidecar binary, node.exe ~70 MB)
guard_snippet: restore chunk-by-chunk AsyncWriteExt::write_all, or hash incrementally with sha2::Digest::update
potential_consequence: Entire file is buffered in heap before disk write; OOM on low-memory devices; disk write deferred until full download completes
